name: Mama Boku Dake o Aishite ~ Kimodebu Musuko o Dekiai Suru Haha no Yuganda Aijou
original_name: ママ僕だけを愛して ～キモデブ息子を溺愛する母の歪んだ愛情
source: Kawahara Youko is a calm and somewhat naive full-time homemaker who supports her husband Satoshi, a local government employee. Lately, due to Satoshi's frequent business trips, Youko has been feeling sexually frustrated. Moreover, being in her prime, her sexual desires have been on the rise. During one of Satoshi's brief returns home from his business trip, they engage in a passionate night. They become aware that Daisuke, their son, is secretly observing them, but instead of reprimanding him, they choose not to criticize. In fact, they accept his presence without judgment and even express concern about his increasing sexual desires. Driven by an abundance of affection, Youko decides to take care of Daisuke's sexual needs, believing it to be the right thing to do. However, this act unintentionally intensifies his physical desires and emotions. Ultimately, Daisuke loses control and crosses intimate boundaries with her. With Youko already grappling with pent-up frustration and her sexual desires increasing, she gets increasingly ensnared in his growing demands.
translation: 河原阳子是一位冷静而又有些天真的全职家庭主妇，她支持当地政府雇员的丈夫Satoshi。最近，由于中本聪频繁出差，阳子一直感到性方面的沮丧。而且，正值风华正茂的时候，她的性欲一直在高涨。在中本聪出差短暂回国期间，他们度过了一个充满激情的夜晚。他们意识到儿子大辅正在暗中观察他们，但他们没有谴责他，而是选择不批评。事实上，他们不加评判地接受他的存在，甚至对他日益增长的性欲表示担忧。在丰富感情的驱使下，阳子决定照顾大辅的性需求，并认为这是正确的做法。然而，这种行为无意中加剧了他的身体欲望和情绪。最终，大介失去了控制并跨越了与她的亲密界限。由于阳子已经在与压抑的挫败感作斗争，而且她的性欲不断增加，她越来越陷入他不断增长的要求中。
